verdict.rationale: pnpm is a CLI with a dedicated continuous-integration doc page. In CI it detects the environment and switches to frozen-lockfile mode, and fails if the lockfile needs an update. It runs as a self-contained executable with no Node.js required, honors the `packageManager` version pin, supports offline and env-var-driven config, and emits JSON audit output. Community reports corroborate fast, reliable CI installs. Missing for 10: documented CI-provider recipes (e.g. store caching setup) and explicit non-interactive/prompt-suppression behavior in the evidence.
